description: This Java class 'JwtTokenVerifier' is a security filter in a Spring application responsible for verifying JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) on incoming HTTP requests. It extends 'OncePerRequestFilter' and handles authentication through JWTs, including refreshing tokens when needed.

classes.name: JwtTokenVerifier
classes.description: A Spring Security filter that intercepts HTTP requests to verify JWT tokens for authentication and handle token refresh scenarios.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Override method to perform JWT verification and handle refresh token logic.

methods.name: updateResponseWithJwtAndRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates new JWT and refresh token, and updates the HTTP response with these tokens.

methods.name: getAuthentication
methods.description: Creates an Authentication object from username and authorities extracted from JWT claims.

methods.name: getJwsClaims
methods.description: Parses a JWT token to extract claims using the secret key.

methods.name: readRefreshTokenMapFromRequest
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a JSON object containing the refresh token from the HTTP request body.
